verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS identity-verification platform, but the evidence pack shows no self-hosted, on-premises or deployable version of Persona. Every integration method (Hosted Flow, Embedded Flow, Mobile SDKs, Transactions API) runs against Persona's own service. Embedding Persona's UI or calling its API is integration with a vendor-run service, not self-hosting the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
